runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; interactive TUI; cursor/default model with low thinking; explicit --skills check-interaction; read and ask tools only; extensions and rules disabled.
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only probe with native interactive user input; no project-write tools

assertions.evidence: The saved session resolved skill://check-interaction to the generated project Skill and returned its complete instructions.
The saved assistant message contains exactly one native ask tool call with both probe questions.
The ask call and rendered TUI presented Amber and Cobalt for probe_color, with Amber marked recommended.
The native ask result recorded selectedOptions=[Cobalt] for probe_color.
The native TUI exposed its custom-answer path for probe_token in addition to Alpha and Beta.
The native ask result independently recorded customInput=violet-42 for probe_token.
Both reported values exactly match the native tool result produced after human TUI input.
The tool completed normally and the final INTERACTION_RESULT reported timed_out=false and success=true.
External post-run Git status showed only the probe session directory as untracked and no tracked project changes.

limitations: This result applies to the interactive TUI, not print mode; print-mode behavior is recorded separately as a fallback.

The passing observation is bound to cursor/default. A separate cursor/gpt-5.6-luna reconnaissance run returned the fallback without invoking the available ask operation, so model behavior is part of the configuration fingerprint.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
